global_gwt_invariant: Every candidate retains specialized processes, competition/selection into a capacity-limited workspace, global addressability/broadcast, receiver-specific reconstruction/uptake/causal use, outcome and provenance-bound re-entry. Local/nested/shadow processes may exist only upstream/downstream of the globally addressable selected episode.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Functional ignition is better operationalized as a sharp transition in globally addressable content plus downstream receiver causal use than as a fixed anatomical or service location.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Ignition-like performance transitions survive physical module relocation if episode identity, broadcast and causal-use semantics are preserved.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Relocation preserving semantics destroys the effect while a location-specific implementation rescues it.
A_CONSERVATIVE.test: H1/H2/H3 differential relocation with frozen model output.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Workspace capacity has an inverted-U relation with useful specialization/robustness: too small misses necessary coalitions, too large removes competitive pressure and admits distractors.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: OOD robustness and causal-use efficiency peak at an intermediate capacity rather than monotonically increasing.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Performance/robustness monotonically improves with capacity under matched compute.
A_CONSERVATIVE.test: Capacity sweep with fixed receivers, frozen outputs and distractor load.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Top-down modality/receiver gating before competition improves robustness when input quality is heterogeneous.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Quality-aware gating lowers harmful uptake and preserves task performance under missing/noisy modalities.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Ungated full competition is equal or better across noise/OOD controls.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Truthful provenance-bound re-entry causally improves nonstationary adaptation beyond extra context alone.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Truthful re-entry outperforms temporally shuffled, receiver-shuffled, provenance-broken and no-reentry controls on future decisions.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Content-preserving provenance-broken or shuffled re-entry is equivalent.
A_CONSERVATIVE.test: Matched re-entry lesion/shuffle/rescue under frozen current-turn model output.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Workspace-relevant state can persist activity-silently and be reactively re-ignited rather than continuously broadcast.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Latent episode state survives idle intervals and becomes causally useful only after context-triggered reactivation.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Continuous active broadcast is necessary for equal retention under matched resources.
A_CONSERVATIVE.test: Persistent-active vs latent-snapshot/reactivation vs no-memory arms.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Repeated selection-broadcast-reentry cycles provide adaptation advantages over single-shot workspace use.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Multi-step dynamic tasks benefit from cycle count until a saturation/echo regime appears.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Single-shot broadcast matches multi-cycle performance at matched compute and memory.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Receiver-specific reconstruction is functionally useful; identical copied broadcast state is not always optimal.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Heterogeneous reconstruction improves specialized downstream causal use without reducing global semantic identity.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: One canonical identical receiver representation dominates all heterogeneous transforms.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Useful workspace dynamics require a balance between segregation/specialization and integration/broadcast rather than maximal coupling.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Metastability, switching quality and OOD task utility decline under both severe undercoupling and overcoupling.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Maximum coupling consistently dominates across tasks and costs.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Macro WorkspaceEpisodes/Assemblies can be useful causal abstractions only when macro interventions have explicit micro-realization semantics.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Natural/defined macro interventions yield stable macro effects; arbitrary macro labels yield confounded or realization-dependent effects.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Arbitrary macro interventions remain stable across micro-realizations.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Transfer entropy or one integration score is insufficient; decomposed information-dynamic atoms better discriminate causal-use patterns.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Episodes with equal aggregate TE/integration can differ in synergy/redundancy/unique-information transitions and behavioral consequences.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Aggregate measures fully predict intervention outcomes across held-out regimes.
A_CONSERVATIVE.test: PhiID/PID decomposition on matched aggregate-TE episodes.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Any claimed higher-order ClayGraph relation must beat the best information-equivalent pairwise/state-machine reduction.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: True higher-order candidates show intervention-response or prediction residuals not reproduced pairwise.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: A weighted pairwise reduction reproduces all relevant probabilities/effects at lower cost.
A_CONSERVATIVE.test: Automated pairwise-reduction tournament per hyperedge candidate.

A_CONSERVATIVE.hypothesis: Fine temporal resolution is required to identify GWT causal order; aggregation can erase or invert apparent directionality.
A_CONSERVATIVE.prediction: Coarse logging changes inferred directed-flow/re-entry structure relative to high-resolution receipts.
A_CONSERVATIVE.falsifier: Causal conclusions are invariant across temporal aggregation levels.
A_CONSERVATIVE.test: Replay identical episodes at several receipt aggregation windows.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: The active receiver/coupling topology should be episode-dependent rather than static while global addressability remains invariant.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Dynamic topology improves task/OOD efficiency over static topology at matched edge budget.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Static topology matches or beats dynamic routing across regimes.
B_AGGRESSIVE.test: Static vs dynamic topology with topology-shuffle controls.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Some task-relevant receiver coalitions form genuine causal hyperedges whose joint effect is absent from all constituent pairs.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Joint lesions/rescues reveal synergistic causal contribution localized to the coalition.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Best pairwise model reproduces intervention response.
B_AGGRESSIVE.test: Optimally conditioned higher-order TE plus intervention and pairwise reduction.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Slow goal/personality/memory state modulates fast workspace competition, creating measurable hysteresis and path dependence.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Identical current input produces different winners after different validated histories; clamping slow state removes the difference.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: History effects persist after all slow-state channels are clamped.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Re-entry has a useful delay band: too-fast re-entry creates echo/self-reinforcement, too-slow re-entry loses causal relevance.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Task utility and causal contribution peak over an intermediate delay range.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Re-entry delay is irrelevant or monotonic across tasks.
B_AGGRESSIVE.test: Delay sweep with echo, instability and cost shadows.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Workspace selection may need explicit inhibitory consequences for incompatible alternatives, not only positive broadcast of the winner.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Bounded suppression reduces false binding and oscillatory reselection in conflict tasks.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Suppression adds no benefit or harms flexibility under matched gating.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Global availability can coexist with sparse physical delivery: addressability to all, actual delivery/uptake only to relevant receivers.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Sparse delivery preserves task behavior while reducing latency/compute and harmful uptake.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Literal all-receiver delivery is necessary for equivalent cross-module transfer.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: A functional workspace causal motif can migrate across physical module boundaries while preserving semantic identity and emergence readouts.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: H1/H2/H3 implementations differ physically but conserve causal episode invariants and lesion signatures.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Observed behavior depends on a particular physical boundary despite semantic equivalence.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: A bounded controller can maintain the system near a useful metastable coupling region without maximizing emergence metrics.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Multi-objective control outperforms naive synergy/broadcast maximization on utility, recovery and false-binding constraints.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Naive emergence-score maximization is equally stable/generalizable.
B_AGGRESSIVE.test: Controller tournament with explicit Goodhart stress tests.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Useful macro causal variables are target-specific rather than one universal emergent macrostate.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Different target outcomes induce different minimal causal reductions/Assemblies.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: One fixed macro representation dominates all targets without information leakage.
B_AGGRESSIVE.test: Targeted causal reduction across multiple outcomes.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Model-readable verified self-observation changes workspace dynamics and therefore must itself be treated as an intervention.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: ReadoutProjector access changes future selection/re-entry relative to blind controls; falsified readouts induce predictable errors.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Self-readout has no measurable downstream effect.
B_AGGRESSIVE.test: Blind vs truthful-readout vs falsified-readout three-arm trial.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Offline/dream replay can instantiate GWT cycles over remembered candidate states and improve later transfer.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Structured replay improves later OOD/recovery more than random replay at matched compute.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: Random/no replay matches structured workspace replay.

B_AGGRESSIVE.hypothesis: Counterfactual shadow workspace simulations can improve later selection if they remain candidate generation rather than execution authority.
B_AGGRESSIVE.prediction: Shadow alternatives improve choice calibration after a subsequent real workspace competition.
B_AGGRESSIVE.falsifier: No gain over direct selection or gains vanish under leakage controls.
B_AGGRESSIVE.test: Generate N counterfactual candidates, prohibit effects, then globally select one.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Multiple local mini-workspaces can pre-integrate domain-specific candidates before one final global workspace competition.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Hierarchical preselection scales better while preserving a single globally addressable selected episode.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Hierarchy loses critical cross-domain candidates or provides no scaling benefit.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Long reasoning episodes are better represented as cascades of short micro-ignitions than as one prolonged workspace state.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Micro-ignition chains improve error localization, revision and re-entry while preserving final coherence.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: One sustained episode dominates under matched compute/state.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Relative logical timing/lag patterns can function as a coordination code even without biological oscillations.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Permuting inter-receiver delays while preserving content changes coordination and outcome in predictable ways.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: All reasonable lag permutations are behaviorally equivalent.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.test: Delay-spectrum perturbation with explicit epoch receipts.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Some higher-order relations should exist only as ignition-time topology pulses and dissolve after re-entry.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Ephemeral hyperedges improve binding without persistent graph overcoupling; permanent equivalents increase false binding.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Persistent edges are equal or superior without stability cost.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: The system can maintain several mutually exclusive counterfactual candidate worlds in Hyperposition, but only one may become the globally broadcast workspace episode at a time.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Preserving incompatible alternatives upstream improves decisions under ambiguity without contaminating actual state.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Alternative preservation adds no value or leaks into authoritative state before selection.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.test: Set-valued candidate branch vs destructive early collapse.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Provenance can be part of causal content: byte-identical re-entry with wrong lineage may rationally produce different future selection.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Lineage-aware system rejects or discounts provenance-broken re-entry even when payload hashes match.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Provenance never changes downstream use under adversarial source substitution.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: WorkspaceEpisodes can act as causal compression packets whose macro intervention preserves task-relevant effects with far fewer state variables than the micro trace.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Episode-level interventions approximate micro interventions within bounded error while improving prediction/generalization efficiency.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Compression destroys intervention equivalence or gives no explanatory gain.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Information roles can transform across timescales, e.g. fast redundant evidence becoming slow synergistic re-entry state.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: PhiID-like atoms show reproducible Red->Syn or Un->Syn transitions around successful multi-cycle episodes.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Atom-transition patterns vanish under controls or are estimator artifacts.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Systematic ignition-threshold/gain sweeps reveal bifurcation and hysteresis surfaces that can be used as a self-calibration map.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: There are repeatable regime boundaries separating undercoupled, useful and echo/overcoupled dynamics.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: A robust emergent mechanism is harder to Goodhart than a decorative metric: optimizing one readout should not destroy task utility if the readout tracks a genuine causal mechanism.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Mechanism-grounded readouts degrade more gracefully under direct optimization than proxy-only scores.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Causally supported readouts are equally exploitable as decorative proxies.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.test: Adversarial optimizer attacks on each readout family.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Functional ignition should be certified post hoc by a receiver causal-use quorum, distinct from the earlier selection event.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Selected/broadcast episodes without sufficient causal-use quorum predict no system-level effect and should remain uncatalogued as functional ignitions.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Selection alone predicts outcomes equally well.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.test: Compare selection-only vs causal-use-certified episode labels.

C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.hypothesis: Specialization itself can emerge from a constrained workspace: modules need not be fully pre-specialized if bandwidth competition and stable receiver roles induce specialization over learning.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.prediction: Under constrained workspace training, modules differentiate more than in unconstrained communication controls.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.falsifier: Specialization does not emerge or requires explicit specialization loss.
C_WILD_BUT_GWT_CONSISTENT.test: Bandwidth-limited vs unlimited communication learning experiment.

promotion_rule: No hypothesis is promoted from this matrix by plausibility or citation count. Require preregistered prediction where feasible, matched nulls, lesion/rescue, truthful-vs-shuffled re-entry, pairwise-reduction controls for higher-order claims, OOD/implementation transfer, cost shadows and independent evaluation proportional to claim strength.
